title: How it works
intro: Whether you choose to visit us locally or order a premium breed from overseas, TeddyPups is here to make the experience unforgettable.

journeys.label: In Dubai
journeys.heading: Meet your puppy in person
journeys.body: Step into our Downtown Dubai showroom and experience the joy of choosing your puppy face-to-face. We source healthy, well-socialized puppies from trusted local breeders, ensuring they're raised with care, proper nutrition, and veterinary checks.

steps.title: Explore our puppies
steps.text: Browse our website to view the available puppies. Each listing includes photos, breed details, age, and health information.

steps.title: Choose your puppy
steps.text: Once you find a puppy you love, open their profile for more information or to enquire further. You can also reach out to us directly if you have any questions.

steps.title: Meet before you choose
steps.text: Spend time bonding before making your decision.

steps.title: Pick-up or delivery
steps.text: Pick up your puppy from us or have them delivered to your home within Dubai. Our delivery service is safe and reliable, ensuring your puppy arrives comfortably.

journeys.label: Imported
journeys.heading: Order upon request
journeys.body: Looking for a truly exceptional companion? Our Order Upon Request service gives you access to some of the world's most sought-after teacup breeds — ethically sourced from the most reputable, certified breeders across Europe, Korea, and beyond.
journeys.note: From Korean teacup poodles to rare Maltese, Pom, and Yorkie lines, we bring the world's finest puppies to Dubai, just for you.

steps.title: Reserve your puppy
steps.text: Browse our selection of available breeds and place a reservation for the teacup puppy that captures your heart. Our reservation-only model ensures that each puppy is specifically sourced to meet your preferences.

steps.title: Personalized consultation
steps.text: Once your reservation is confirmed, we will work closely with you to finalize details and provide updates on your puppy's journey.

steps.title: Import and arrival
steps.text: We manage all aspects of the import process, including health checks, travel arrangements, and necessary documentation. Your puppy will be carefully transported and will arrive ready to join your family.

steps.title: Welcome home
steps.text: Upon arrival, we provide support to help your new puppy acclimate to their new environment. Our team is available for any additional assistance and to ensure a smooth transition into your home.

entries.title: Hand-selected breeders
entries.text: We work only with breeders who uphold the highest ethical and health standards.

entries.title: Full transparency
entries.text: Photos, videos, and health certificates are shared before your puppy travels.

entries.title: Safe, stress-free delivery
entries.text: We handle every detail of the import process, so your puppy arrives happy, healthy, and ready to love you.

delivery.title: Delivery & collection
delivery.intro: From a same-day visit in Downtown Dubai to a flight from Korea, every puppy travels comfortably and arrives safely.

items.title: Take your puppy home the same day
items.text: Local puppies are available immediately — visit, fall in love, and go home together.

items.title: Delivery within Dubai
items.text: Prefer to stay home? We deliver your puppy to your door within Dubai, safely and comfortably.

items.title: Safe international cargo
items.text: We handle all the paperwork and ensure comfortable travel so your puppy arrives happy and stress-free.

items.title: Worldwide delivery
items.text: We safely deliver puppies to loving homes all around the world. Our trusted international cargo partners ensure your new furry friend travels comfortably and arrives safely, no matter the distance.

why.title: Why choose us
why.intro: We're here to help you find a new family member. From the moment you visit our site to the joyful day your puppy arrives at your door, we're with you every step of the way. Our mission is to make the entire adoption process smooth, transparent, and full of love.

items.title: International cargo
items.text: We safely deliver puppies to loving homes all around the world. Our trusted international cargo partners ensure your new furry friend travels comfortably and arrives safely, no matter the distance.

items.title: Support 24/7
items.text: Our team is available 24/7 to answer your questions and assist you through every step of the adoption process. From choosing your puppy to post-delivery support — we're just a message away.

items.title: Health guarantee
items.text: All our puppies come with a verified health certificate from licensed vets. We ensure every puppy is vaccinated, dewormed, and thoroughly checked before joining your family.

care.title: Unique and high quality puppies
care.text: When you choose TeddyPups, you can trust that you're getting a puppy of the highest quality. We also provide guidance and support to new pet owners, offering advice on training, nutrition, and general care to ensure a smooth transition for you and your new furry friend.
